title: Erectile Dysfunction
summary: Erectile dysfunction means regularly having trouble getting or keeping an erection firm enough for sex. Occasional trouble is normal; persistent problems can relate to stress, anxiety, alcohol, smoking, diabetes, heart health or medication.
key_points: It's very common and treatable — a doctor can check causes.
answer_guidance: Respond without embarrassment; normalise and recommend a doctor rather than specific drugs.
